text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-san. I knew you would come.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I felt a familiar, refreshing breeze 
blowing a short while ago, you see.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Still, this really is a wonderful breeze. 
So much so that I just want to quietly 
take it in like this...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you won't be able to train like 
that. Just think of it as a gentle breeze 
from a feather.
